title: Data Security
text: All company data must be protected against unauthorized access.

title: Encryption
text:
All sensitive data must be encrypted using AES-256.
- Encryption keys must be rotated every 90 days.
- Access to encryption keys is restricted.
context: Specifies encryption standards and key management.

title: Data Retention
text:
Data must be retained for a minimum of 7 years.
• Data older than 7 years must be deleted securely.
context: Describes data retention and deletion policy.

title: Access Control
text: Access to systems must be role-based.

title: User Authentication
text:
All users must authenticate using multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Passwords must be at least 12 characters.
* Passwords must be changed every 180 days.
context: Specifies user authentication and password policy.

title: Auditing
text: Audit logs must be maintained for all critical systems.
